cards.card_text: Bildad says drying up like that is the destiny of all who ___ God, and the hope of the godless will perish.
cards.verse_text: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
cards.snippet: …the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.

cards.card_text: Job says this will be his salvation, because no godless man can appear before God.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.
cards.snippet: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.

cards.card_text: Eliphaz says the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
cards.verse_text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
cards.snippet: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

cards.card_text: And he asks what hope the godless man has when he is cut off, when God takes away his life.
cards.verse_text: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
cards.snippet: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

cards.card_text: True or false: Elihu says God watches over man and nation so that godless men should not rule.
cards.verse_text: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.
cards.snippet: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.

cards.card_text: The godless in heart are different, Elihu says: they harbor resentment, and even when God binds them, they don't cry for help.
cards.verse_text: The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when He binds them, they do not cry for help.
cards.snippet: The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when He binds them, they do not…

cards.card_text: True or false: David says his attackers gnashed their teeth at him like godless jesters at a feast.
cards.verse_text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
cards.snippet: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

cards.card_text: Every one of them is godless and wicked They refused to leave the land They bowed down to Aram's gods
cards.verse_text: For every one of them is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks folly.
cards.snippet: For every one of them is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks folly.

cards.card_text: Then God says He'll send Assyria against a godless nation, a people destined for His rage.
cards.verse_text: I will send him against a godless nation; I will dispatch him against a people destined for My rage, to take spoils and seize plunder, and to trample them down like clay in the streets.
cards.snippet: I will send him against a godless nation; I will dispatch him against a people destined for My rage,…

cards.card_text: Next: see to it that no one is sexually immoral, or godless like Esau, Jacob's older twin brother (Genesis 25:24-26).
cards.verse_text: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
